items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I heard Monk at U of R. ... That’s the only time I saw Monk, and it’s the only time I saw a concert at U of R.

ctx.x: Right. Did you get into Rochester much as a kid, fairly close, to hear any music in there? You wound up going to Eastman, right?
I heard Monk at U of R.
